title: Cosmoner app template
description: Deployment template for a Cosmoner app, committed to a repository as .cosmoner/deployment.yaml or deployment.yaml at the root. The deploy wizard reads it and fills its form in from the service you pick.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editors that read it from the document.

version.description: Version of the file format. Optional: a file without it is read as version 1, which is the only version there is.

name.description: Display name for the deployment described by this file.

region.description: Region slug to preselect, e.g. `ams`. Ignored when the slug is not one you can deploy to.

environment.description: Which environment from_variable and from_secret resolve against. Defaults to `default`, and an environment-specific entry wins over the `default` one of the same name.

name.description: Identifies the service within this file. Shown in the wizard when the file defines several.

type.description: `service` runs a long-lived process on a port; `static` builds once and is served as files.

source_dir.description: Directory the service is built from, relative to the repository root wherever this file lives — `.` is the root. Defaults to the root.

strategy.description: `docker` builds the Dockerfile in source_dir; `nixpacks` detects the language. Defaults to auto-detection.

command.description: Build command. Leave unset to use the detected default. Ignored by `docker` builds, which run the Dockerfile.

output_dir.description: Directory the build writes the site into, relative to source_dir. Static sites only.

run_command.description: Command that starts the service. Web services only; overrides the image's default command.

port.description: Port the process listens on. Usually unnecessary: the app is given its port in the PORT environment variable, so a service that listens on $PORT needs nothing here. Without it, a Dockerfile's EXPOSE is used, then 8080.

instance_size.description: Size slug to preselect, e.g. `k8s-s`. Ignored when the slug is not one you can buy.

autodeploy.description: Deploy automatically on every push to the selected branch.

envs.description: Environment variables available at build and run time.

key.description: Name of the environment variable as the app reads it.

value.description: Literal value, committed with the file. Only for non-sensitive configuration.

secret.description: Marks the variable as sensitive without giving it a value: the deploy wizard asks for the value and stores it masked. Never commit a secret value — reference a stored secret with from_secret instead.

from_variable.description: Name of a project variable to link. The app reads the stored value at build and run time.

from_secret.description: Name of a stored secret to link. The value stays in the vault — it is never written into this file, shown in the wizard, or returned by the API.

services.description: The services this repository deploys. Each deploy sets up one of them.
